message: As a grandparent, I find that teaching kids about preparedness can be a bit like herding cats! 🐱 It’s important to make it fun while showing them how to gather the essentials for unexpected moments. I love turning it into a little adventure, where we pick out supplies together and talk about why each item is useful. It's all about creating a sense of security, and who knows, we might even learn a few things along the way! What little tips have you found work with your family?
